authorization: Organization context must resolve through membership; submission requires research:plan in both token and server role. Status reads require dataset:read and tenant RLS.
submission: Requires Idempotency-Key, pinned stored version, proven preservation rights and approved native variable. Typed region/time validation limits requests to 31 days. Submission returns 503 unless application state explicitly enables an acquisition worker.
durability: Requests persist in PostgreSQL. Workers claim under SKIP LOCKED, receive expiring fencing tokens, and can recover expired leases. Late completions cannot overwrite recovered attempts. Success requires a snapshot from the same tenant and version.
pending: Production executor configuration, source-specific geometry/index bounds and content validation, project entitlements, concurrency stress tests and full G03 remain unfinished. Request digest binding and atomic worker publication are implemented; see P03-acquisition-worker.json.
baseline: Deferred by user; no scientific readiness claim.
